scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal
Applicant must be a migrant worker employed outside West Bengal or outside India
Applicant must be registered with the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board
Disability must be at least 40% and caused by an accident during work
Disability must be certified by a Government Hospital
benefits_summary: One-time assistance of ₹50,000 for 40‑80% disability and ₹1,00,000 for more than 80% disability.
